create_swav_momentum_loss: create a SwAVMomentumLoss instance from an AttrDict configuration for self-supervised contrastive training
initialize_queue: initialize the SwAV momentum loss queue buffers for storing embeddings and prototype scores across iterations
compute_queue_scores: compute prototype scores for queued embeddings using the momentum encoder's prototype heads
run_distributed_sinkhornknopp: run the distributed Sinkhorn-Knopp algorithm to compute balanced cluster assignments from score matrices
update_emb_queue: update the embedding queue by shifting old embeddings and inserting new momentum encoder embeddings
